answer: Locks are entered in harbor, expire in sparrow, and kernel lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 20 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A hostile operator running 44 aliases therefore needs 44 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 975 identities would post 4883 proofs and burn roughly 41 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
